Class PythonJavaBases

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.context.python.PythonJavaBases
@Internal public final class PythonJavaBases extends Object
The runtime side of a Python class that extends a Java class.

The Java class generated for such a Python class extends the Java base and is the only Java instance of it. At run time the Java base is replaced in the Python class by a Python base class (created by baseClass(Class)) that records the arguments of super().__init__(...) and defines a Python method for every accessible instance method of the Java base. Those methods reach the base implementation through the Java instance bound to the Python object (bind(Value, ValueCoercible)), which the generated constructors create from the recorded arguments. A Python object created in Python code gets its Java instance the first time an inherited method is called.

Since:
5.2.0

Micronaut Team

    • constructing

      public static PythonJavaBases.Construction constructing(org.graalvm.polyglot.Value pythonObject, Class<?> javaClass)
      Marks the Python object whose Java instance is being constructed on the current thread. The generated (Value) constructor evaluates this before it runs the Java super constructor, which may call a method the Python class overrides: until the instance holds its Python object, the bridge of that method reaches it through underConstruction(Class).
      Parameters:
      pythonObject - The Python object
      javaClass - The generated Java class being constructed
      Returns:
      The construction, finished by the constructor once the super constructor returned

    • underConstruction

      public static @Nullable org.graalvm.polyglot.Value underConstruction(Class<?> javaClass)
      The Python object whose Java instance of the given class is being constructed on the current thread, for a bridge method called by the Java super constructor; null outside such a construction. Constructions nest when a super constructor creates the Java instance of another Python object, so the asking class selects the innermost construction of its own class.
      Parameters:
      javaClass - The generated Java class of the asking instance
      Returns:
      The Python object, or null
